# Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Node.js TypeScript Application

## Project Structure
```
project/
├── src/
│   └── index.ts
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── Dockerfile
```

## Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# ============================================================
# Stage 1: Base — shared foundation with common configuration
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS base

# Set working directory for all subsequent stages
WORKDIR /app

# Install dumb-init for proper signal handling and PID 1 management
# This ensures graceful shutdowns work correctly in containers
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# ============================================================
# Stage 2: Dependencies — install ALL dependencies (dev + prod)
# ============================================================
FROM base AS dependencies

# Copy only package files first to leverage Docker layer caching.
# This layer is only rebuilt when package.json or lock file changes.
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install all dependencies including devDependencies needed for TypeScript compilation
# --frozen-lockfile ensures reproducible installs
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile

# ============================================================
# Stage 3: Builder — compile TypeScript to JavaScript
# ============================================================
FROM dependencies AS builder

# Copy TypeScript configuration
COPY tsconfig.json ./

# Copy source code
COPY src/ ./src/

# Compile TypeScript → JavaScript
# Output goes to /app/dist as configured in tsconfig.json
RUN npm run build

# ============================================================
# Stage 4: Production Dependencies — install only prod packages
# ============================================================
FROM base AS prod-dependencies

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install ONLY production dependencies, skipping devDependencies
# This creates a clean, minimal node_modules for the final image
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile --omit=dev

# ============================================================
# Stage 5: Release — final minimal production image
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS release

# Install dumb-init in the final stage as well
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# Create a non-root user and group for security
# Running as root inside a container is a security risk
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs && \
    adduser  --system --uid 1001 --ingroup nodejs nodeuser

WORKDIR /app

# Copy only what's needed from previous stages:
# 1. Production node_modules from prod-dependencies stage
COPY --from=prod-dependencies --chown=nodeuser:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# 2. Compiled JavaScript from builder stage
COPY --from=builder --chown=nodeuser:nodejs /app/dist ./dist

# 3. package.json (needed for npm scripts and metadata)
COPY --chown=nodeuser:nodejs package.json ./

# Switch to non-root user before running the application
USER nodeuser

# Document the port the application listens on (informational)
EXPOSE 3000

# Set NODE_ENV to production for performance optimizations
ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Health check to verify the application is running correctly
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=15s --retries=3 \
    CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/health', (r) => { process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1) })"

# Use dumb-init as PID 1 to handle signals properly
# This prevents zombie processes and ensures clean shutdowns
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]

# Start the compiled application
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Supporting Files

### `tsconfig.json`
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": false,
    "sourceMap": false,
    "removeComments": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noImplicitReturns": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist"]
}
```

### `package.json`
```json
{
  "name": "my-ts-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Node.js TypeScript application",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "ts-node src/index.ts",
    "lint": "eslint src/**/*.ts",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^20.10.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.0.0"
  }
}
```

### `.dockerignore`
```dockerignore
# Version control
.git
.gitignore

# Dependencies (will be installed fresh in Docker)
node_modules

# Build output (will be compiled fresh in Docker)
dist

# Development and test files
**/*.test.ts
**/*.spec.ts
**/__tests__
coverage

# Environment files (use Docker secrets or env vars instead)
.env
.env.*
!.env.example

# Editor and OS files
.vscode
.idea
*.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# Documentation
README.md
docs/

# CI/CD
.github
.gitlab-ci.yml

# Docker files (not needed inside the image)
Dockerfile
docker-compose*.yml
```

### `src/index.ts` (Example Application)
```typescript
import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT ?? 3000;

app.use(express.json());

// Health check endpoint (used by Docker HEALTHCHECK)
app.get('/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.status(200).json({
    status: 'healthy',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    uptime: process.uptime(),
  });
});

app.get('/', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json({ message: 'Hello from TypeScript!' });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`);
});

export default app;
```

## Build & Run Commands

```bash
# Build the image
docker build -t my-ts-app:latest .

# Build with no cache (force fresh build)
docker build --no-cache -t my-ts-app:latest .

# Run the container
docker run -p 3000:3000 my-ts-app:latest

# Run with environment variables
docker run -p 3000:3000 -e NODE_ENV=production my-ts-app:latest

# Run in detached mode
docker run -d -p 3000:3000 --name my-ts-app my-ts-app:latest

# Check image size
docker image inspect my-ts-app:latest --format='{{.Size}}' | \
  awk '{printf "%.2f MB\n", $1/1024/1024}'

# View all stage sizes during build
docker build --target builder -t my-ts-app:builder .
docker build --target prod-dependencies -t my-ts-app:prod-deps .
```

## Stage Summary

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Build Stage Pipeline                         │
├──────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Stage            │ Purpose                                      │
├──────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ base             │ Alpine + dumb-init foundation                │
│ dependencies     │ All deps (dev + prod) for compilation        │
│ builder          │ TypeScript → JavaScript compilation          │
│ prod-dependencies│ Production-only node_modules                 │
│ release          │ Final image: compiled JS + prod deps only    │
└──────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Final image contains ONLY:
  ✅ node:20-alpine base (~50MB)
  ✅ dumb-init binary
  ✅ Production node_modules
  ✅ Compiled dist/ JavaScript
  ✅ package.json

Final image excludes:
  ❌ TypeScript compiler
  ❌ devDependencies
  ❌ Source .ts files
  ❌ tsconfig.json
  ❌ Build tools
```

## Key Optimizations Explained

| Technique | Benefit |
|-----------|---------|
| `node:20-alpine` base | ~3x smaller than `node:20` (debian) |
| Multi-stage builds | Dev tools never reach final image |
| Separate prod-deps stage | Clean `node_modules` without devDeps |
| `COPY package*.json` first | Layer cache reused when source changes |
| `npm ci --frozen-lockfile` | Reproducible, faster than `npm install` |
| Non-root user | Security hardening |
| `dumb-init` | Proper signal handling, no zombie processes |
| `.dockerignore` | Prevents unnecessary files in build context |
| `sourceMap: false` | Smaller compiled output |
| `removeComments: true` | Smaller compiled output |
